subject: Upcoming Travel Booking Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], We are excited to confirm your upcoming travel booking to Paris on 15th August 2022. Your flight details and hotel reservation are all set. Please review the attached itinerary for more information. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out to our customer support. We look forward to providing you with a memorable travel experience. Safe travels! Best regards, Travel Agency Team
